summary: Formulated 2 attack hypotheses based on identified invariants and architectural surface area.

hypotheses.title: Privilege Escalation via Unknown Root Contract
hypotheses.description: An attacker might bypass State Transition Integrity by exploiting uninitialized state or missing modifiers in administrative functions.
hypotheses.recommendedNextStep: Trace all 'onlyOwner' or similar access control paths in Unknown Root Contract.

hypotheses.title: Internal Accounting Desync in Unknown Root Contract
hypotheses.description: External token transfers might cause internal state balances to desync from actual contract holdings, potentially locking or draining funds.
hypotheses.recommendedNextStep: Review ERC20 'transfer' and 'transferFrom' return value handling and balance checkpoints.
